caption: The drawing features a figure of a woman in profile, facing left, depicted with pale skin and brown hair. She is wearing a green, draped garment that reaches her ankles and a yellowish-brown head covering or wreath. The woman holds a bundle of golden wheat under her left arm, with her right hand resting on it, and her right arm hanging at her side. She is standing with her left foot forward and lifted onto a brown rock or ledge, with her right foot not visible. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or decoration. The composition centers the figure, and the colors are primarily earthy tones of green, brown, and gold.
title: Figurehead: "Ceres"
